subject: [PATCH v2 1/2] arm64: sdei: Run the event handler on the kernel vectors

reviews.author: Kiryl Shutsemau (author)
reviews.summary: The author acknowledged that the current implementation of __sdei_handler() does not handle the case where VBAR_EL1 holds the trampoline vectors, and explained how they plan to fix this by switching to the kernel vectors when necessary.

reviews.author: Catalin Marinas
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that irqs_disabled() may be false due to preempt debugging and pseudo-NMIs, which would cause a warning in __this_cpu_read(), and suggested using raw_cpu_read() or saving/restoring PMR and priorities similar to kernel_entry code.
reviews.raw_body:
Sashiko had a comment that the above should be raw_cpu_read() since with
preempt debugging and pseudo-NMIs, irqs_disabled() is false here and the
check in __this_cpu_read() will warn.

Thinking about it, further down on the irqentry_nmi_enter() ->
lockdep_hardirqs_off() we'll hit the irqs_disabled() issue again. We
could just do a raw_local_irq_save/restore() around this function.
Unnecessary for DAIF but useful with pseudo-NMIs.

Alternatively, __sdei_asm_handler() could save/restore PMR and change
the priorities similar to the kernel_entry code. Actually, this may be
better since do_sdei_event() also checks regs_irqs_disabled() and we
don't have any regs->pmr populated.

Worth a separate patch to fix SDEI handling with pseudo-NMI on and no
changes to __this_cpu_read() above needed. So, for this patch:

Reviewed-by: Catalin Marinas <catalin.marinas@arm.com>

(I'll probably queue it for -rc but waiting to see if there are more
comments)

-- 
Catalin

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch fixes an issue where SDEI events dispatched to the kernel vectors in user space cause a CPU hang due to undefined instruction exceptions. The patch installs the kernel vectors in the __sdei_handler function when VBAR_EL1 holds trampoline vectors, and restores it before returning to firmware. This ensures that exceptions taken by the handler execute correctly and do not loop forever. Additionally, this change covers irqentry_nmi_enter() and irqentry_nmi_exit(), which can also take an exception. The patch addresses a problem where SDEI events dispatched in user space cause CPU hangs due to undefined instruction exceptions.
